name: Strategic minimalism
fit: One clear action per view; ruthless reduction without burying data.
feel: Focused, calm, intentional empty space that earns its keep.
surfaces: Sparse chrome; progressive disclosure; large quiet fields.
type: Few sizes; one primary action voice.
color: Near-monochrome with a single CTA color.
avoid: Aesthetic emptiness that hides required data.
adapt: Keep singular CTAs and progressive disclosure.
